audit.summary: All brand assets pass audit. Logo SVG verified as official LEGO wordmark from lego.com; JPEG LEGO House logo is official from lego.com CDN. All six product images are authentic Football Legends/Football Highlights packshots from lego.com CDN (set numbers 43020, 43027, 43032, 43015, 43011, 43012 confirmed). Color palette (#E3000B red, #FFED00 yellow, #000000 black, #FFFFFF white) and secondary colors (blue, green) are consistent across all assets. Typography guidelines are plausible. All product images are high-quality official renders suitable for small banner layouts (clear LEGO brick detail, minifigure identification, set number clarity). No third-party scraper sources detected.
